exam_eligibility_hours: at least 7,000 hours of on-the-job training
issuing_authority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
prerequisite: under the supervision of a Master Electrician licensed in Texas
source_quote: To apply for a Journeyman Electrician license, you must have completed at least 7,000 hours of on-the-job training under the supervision of a Master Electrician licensed in Texas. Submitting at least 7,000 hours of on-the-job training will simply allow you to take the examination before reaching the full 8,000 hours required for licensure.
verification_method: Experience Verification Form signed by each supervising Master Electrician

issuing_authority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
prerequisite: must have held Journeyman Electrician license for at least two years. Note that Journeyman Industrial Electrician experience may not be used to qualify for a Master Electrician license.
source_quote: Note that Journeyman Industrial Electrician experience may not be used to qualify for a Master Electrician license. You must also be able to show that you have completed 12,000 hours of on-the-job training under the supervision of a Master Electrician licensed in Texas.
verification_method: Experience Verification Form signed by each supervising Master Electrician
